brief:
Israel is intensifying enforcement against international volunteers in the occupied West Bank, arresting and deporting foreign activists as settler violence escalates during the olive harvest season, Middle East Eye reported. The crackdown has also resulted in entry bans preventing activists from returning to the territory.

The timing coincides with a surge in attacks by settlers against Palestinians harvesting olives, a critical seasonal activity. International volunteers have traditionally monitored these harvests and documented incidents, positioning themselves as witnesses to potential violence. Israeli authorities are now targeting these observers through arrests and expulsion procedures.
dek: ‘Will you stand watch with me?’ Israel cracks down on foreign activists in West Bank Submitted by Kate McMahon on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 14:54 As settler attacks intensify during the olive harvest, international volunteers face arrest, deportation and entry bans…
title: Israel arrests and deports foreign activists from West Bank
